name: o-json: reshape a document in the viewer

actions.label: Give a field a clearer name
actions.caption: r opens title for renaming; type heading and esc to keep it. Clarify the output key while preserving its original value.

actions.label: Put a copy above the current field
actions.caption: y y copies title and P puts it above. Copy a field in the output without altering its source.

actions.label: Nest a field into the object below
actions.caption: > j moves title into the next object, container. Group this field with the review metadata instead of leaving it at the document root.

actions.label: Keep only a marked field
actions.caption: space marks title, then g p keeps only the marked branch and its ancestors. Reduce an output to the fields the next tool needs.

actions.label: Make rows from marked fields
actions.caption: space marks title, then F flattens it into an array of rows. Make a small, exportable table from selected fields.

actions.label: File records under their IDs
actions.caption: g g and four j motions select records; g k opens key-by. Enter opens the field choices, enter picks id, and a final enter runs it so each record can be addressed by its ID.

actions.label: Copy a key while reshaping
actions.caption: y k copies the selected key title. Keep the output field name ready for a query or another structure.

actions.label: Copy an output path
actions.caption: y p copies .title from the edited tree. Use the output path when checking what the reshape will produce.

actions.label: Query the output path
actions.caption: ! ! sends .title to the jq line and runs it. Check a reshaped field against its current data.

actions.label: Paste a small outline
actions.caption: Paste notes and an indented reviewed line to create nested object keys in the output. Sketch a grouping structure quickly before moving source fields into it.

actions.label: Leave EDIT and keep the reshape
actions.caption: esc leaves EDIT and restores SHAPE. Continue reading the edited document without making further structural changes.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
